title: $j_!$ on $D_{\mathrm{cons}}$
statement:
Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring ([sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring]) and let $j\colon U\to X$ be an open immersion of the setting of [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]. Write $\iota_T\colon D_{\mathrm{cons}}(T,\Lambda)\hookrightarrow D(\Mod_{\Lambda_T})$, for $T=U,X$, for the full-subcategory inclusions of [sk-def-sfb-bounded-constructible]. Let $J=D(j_!)\colon D(\Mod_{\Lambda_U})\to D(\Mod_{\Lambda_X})$ be the levelwise functor of the exact extension by zero of [sk-def-sfb-module-lower-shriek], with $D(-)$ as in [sk-def-sfb-derived-categories].

Define the extension by zero
$$
j_!\colon D_{\mathrm{cons}}(U,\Lambda)\to D_{\mathrm{cons}}(X,\Lambda)
$$
as the restriction of $J$: its value at an object $K$ is the ambient object $J(\iota_U K)$ equipped with the bounded-constructibility property supplied by [lem-sfb-dc-open-lower-shriek-preserves], and its value at a morphism $a\colon K\to L$ is $J(\iota_U a)$, regarded as a morphism in the full subcategory. The compatibility with the inclusions is the canonical natural isomorphism
$$
\iota_X\circ j_!\cong J\circ\iota_U
$$
whose component at $K$ is the identity of $J(\iota_U K)$.
